title: Tap World.
body: Every flight you've saved, on one sphere.
The comets are the flights still ahead.

title: Nine trips. One planet.
body: Not a map tile in sight: the earth is
drawn per pixel by one Skia shader.

title: Flick it.
It keeps turning.
body: Gestures run on the UI thread —
no JavaScript between finger and frame.

title: Recenter.
body: Back to the fit of your routes,

title: Double-tap
to zoom in.
body: Coastlines sharpen and borders fade in
as you get closer — 10 m detail in tiles.

title: Drag around.
body: once there is room for them.

title: Open the flight.
body: The trip page draws the same globe
as its map — static, framed on the route.

title: Dark mode is free.
body: The textures are masks; the shader
paints them in the theme's colours.
